items.name: Single Room (Stanza Singola)
items.notes: Prices vary based on location (center is more expensive) and building condition.

items.name: Shared Room (Posto Letto)
items.notes: A bed in a double room.

items.name: Utilities (Bollette)
items.notes: Includes electricity, gas, water, and internet. Highly variable.

items.name: Groceries
items.notes: Shopping at supermarkets like Coop, Conad, or discounters like Lidl and Eurospin.

items.name: University Mensa (Canteen)
items.notes: A full meal (primo, secondo, contorno) at a subsidized price.

items.name: Pizza at a Pizzeria
items.notes: For a standard pizza and a drink.

items.name: Monthly Student Bus Pass
items.notes: Provides unlimited travel on buses and the Minimetrò.
